pages.text: Every reaction is electrons moving from where they are to where they would rather be. The $(item)Electrolytic Cell$() pushes them with a voltage instead of waiting.

It makes $(item)Electride Crystals$() (salts whose negative ions are bare electrons), $(fluid)Ionic Liquid$() (molten salt at room temperature), and with superacid research, $(fluid)Carborane Superacid$() - a million million times stronger than sulfuric acid.
A salt whose negative ions are bare electrons sitting in holes in the lattice.$(br2)Made in $(item)Electrolytic Cell$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Electride Crystal$(): Carborane Superacid, Room-Temperature Superconductor
$(fluid)Ionic Liquid$(). Made in $(item)Electrolytic Cell$().$(br)Used for: Absolute Singularity, Autocatalytic Broth, Carbon Nanotube Bundle, Carborane Superacid, Metal-Organic Framework.
$(fluid)Carborane Superacid$(). Made in $(item)Electrolytic Cell$().$(br)Used for: Positronium Hydride, Primordial Soup.
